original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州因洪水担忧重组和平委员会
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹湖泊州一个社区和平委员会因强降雨和洪水引发对族群暴力重燃的担忧而进行重组，引入更年轻的牛营领袖。Peace Canal与湖泊州和平建设部本周审查并续期了2020年成立的Akut-dor和平委员会，14名成员被替换。有社区领袖表示，洪水可能迫使牛营迁往高地，增加袭击风险。

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹湖泊州一个社区和平委员会因洪水担忧而重组
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A community peace committee in South Sudan’s Lakes State has been restructured to bring in younger cattle-camp leaders as heavy rains and flooding raise concerns about renewed communal violence.

key_facts.fact: Peace Canal与湖泊州和平建设部本周审查并续期了2020年成立的Akut-dor和平委员会
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Peace Canal, working with the Lakes State Ministry of Peacebuilding, this week reviewed and renewed the Akut-dor peace committee, established in 2020 with 45 members, including 11 women.

key_facts.fact: 14名成员被更年轻的牛营领袖替换，其中包括4名女性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Fourteen members have been replaced by younger cattle-camp leaders, including four women.

key_facts.fact: 社区领袖称洪水可能迫使牛营迁往高地，增加袭击风险
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sultan Gor Kerthiet, a community leader attending the meeting, said flooding could force cattle camps to move to higher ground, potentially increasing the risk of attacks.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
洪水是否实际导致族群暴力重燃尚未证实
